name: skies-node-sdk
description: The Skies convention framework for plain TypeScript and Express applications.

scripts.clean: node -e "import('node:fs').then(({rmSync}) => { for (const path of ['packages/core/dist', 'packages/express/dist', 'packages/cli/dist']) rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true }); })"
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build --workspace @skiesjs/core && npm run build --workspace @skiesjs/express && npm run build --workspace @skiesjs/cli
scripts.test: npm run build && vitest run && node packages/eslint-plugin-skies-node/index.test.js
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
